description: This file defines a static class 'TypeScriptSerializer' providing JSON serialization and deserialization functionalities for DTOs/models in a backend project. It configures serialization options such as camel case property names, ignoring null values, and indented formatting.

classes.name: TypeScriptSerializer
classes.description: Provides static methods to serialize and deserialize objects to and from JSON using configured options.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object of generic type T to a JSON string using predefined options.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an object of generic type T using predefined options.

methods.name: GetOptions
methods.description: Returns the current JsonSerializerOptions used for serialization and deserialization.
